mapper.select: SELECT DATE(base_datetime) as base_date, total_asset, realized_profit FROM wallet_daily_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(base_datetime) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY base_datetime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_daily_snapshot ( user_id, base_datetime, total_asset, realized_profit ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{baseDatetime}, #{totalAsset}, #{realizedProfit} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_asset = VALUES(total_asset), realized_profit = VALUES(realized_profit)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(s.base_datetime) as base_date, s.total_asset, s.realized_profit FROM wallet_daily_snapshot s INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, DATE(base_datetime) as snapshot_date, MAX(base_datetime) as last_datetime FROM wallet_daily_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(base_datetime) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY user_id, DATE(base_datetime) ) latest ON s.user_id = latest.user_id AND s.base_datetime = latest.last_datetime ORDER BY base_date
SELECT base_datetime, total_asset FROM wallet_daily_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND base_datetime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY base_datetime ASC
